section: Infections Caused by Gram Negative Bacteria
source: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection, 4th Edition, 1/May/2026

questions.stemEn: A 4-day-old neonate presented with conjunctival discharge. Swab results came as intracellular Gram-negative diplococci. What will you give him?
questions.explanationAr: وجود intracellular Gram-negative diplococci في مسحة إفرازات العين يشير إلى gonococcal ophthalmia neonatorum. بحسب شرح المصدر، العلاج يكون systemic ceftriaxone وليس علاجًا موضعيًا فقط.
questions.reasoningEn: The source identifies intracellular gram-negative diplococci as diagnostic of gonorrhea and gives systemic ceftriaxone as treatment.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Topical erythromycin وحده لا يعالج العدوى الجهازية المحتملة، وsilver nitrate وسيلة وقاية وليست علاجًا للحالة المثبتة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Gonococcal ophthalmia neonatorum requires systemic therapy.
managementSteps: Treat systemically as gonococcal ophthalmia neonatorum per the source.

questions.stemEn: A mother who has untreated gonorrhea gave birth to a healthy asymptomatic boy. He received prophylactic eye ointment. What is the most appropriate next step?

options.text: Keep frequently washing the eyes with saline until discharge

questions.explanationAr: الطفل asymptomatic لكنه مولود لأم لديها untreated gonorrhea، ولذلك يعتبر high risk. وفق شرح المصدر لا تكفي prophylactic eye ointment ويحتاج systemic ceftriaxone.
questions.reasoningEn: The source states that asymptomatic infants born to mothers with untreated gonorrhea remain at high risk and should receive systemic ceftriaxone.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: العلاج الموضعي أو الغسيل فقط لا يكفيان، وطمأنة الأسرة دون systemic treatment لا تتوافق مع شرح المصدر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Exposure to untreated maternal gonorrhea may require systemic neonatal therapy even without symptoms.
managementSteps: Give systemic ceftriaxone according to the source.

questions.stemEn: A child diagnosed with acute otitis media was started on penicillin. After 8 hours he became irritable and sick, was no longer interactive, and developed a non-blanching rash. What will you do next?
questions.explanationAr: التدهور السريع مع altered interaction وnon-blanching rash يوحي بـ meningococcal sepsis/meningitis. شرح المصدر يختار IV ceftriaxone كعلاج تجريبي أولي pending susceptibility.
questions.reasoningEn: The source interprets the vignette as meningococcal sepsis/meningitis and recommends ceftriaxone pending susceptibility results.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Tympanometry لا يعالج الحالة الجهازية الخطرة، وCT brain ليس الخطوة العلاجية الأولى قبل بدء المضاد المناسب.
questions.clinicalPearl: Non-blanching rash plus systemic toxicity is a meningococcal red flag.
managementSteps: Start empiric ceftriaxone per the source.

questions.stemEn: A 5-year-old boy presented to the ER with decreased level of consciousness, fever, and a non-blanching rash. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: الصورة السريرية توحي بـ meningococcal disease. حسب شرح المصدر، N. meningitidis تظهر كـ Gram-negative diplococci.
questions.reasoningEn: The source links meningococcal disease with gram-negative diplococci.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Gram-positive diplococci توحي أكثر بـ Streptococcus pneumoniae، وبقية الخيارات أقل دقة مورفولوجيًا.
questions.clinicalPearl: Meningococcus is classically a gram-negative diplococcus.

questions.stemEn: A 2-month-old infant was admitted to PICU with pertussis and severe respiratory distress requiring mechanical ventilation. WBC was 30,000 with lymphocytosis. He improved and was extubated, but SpO2 is 87%. What is the most important reason to do echocardiography?
questions.explanationAr: في severe pertussis عند الرضع، استمرار hypoxemia بعد التحسن يرفع القلق من pulmonary hypertension. المصدر يذكر أن echocardiography تُجرى في critically ill infants لاكتشافها مبكرًا.
questions.reasoningEn: The source states echocardiography should be performed in critically ill infants with pertussis to detect pulmonary hypertension.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر لا يربط سبب إجراء echo هنا بـ myocarditis أو pericarditis.
questions.clinicalPearl: Severe pertussis in infants can be complicated by pulmonary hypertension.
managementSteps: Obtain echocardiography to assess pulmonary hypertension per the source.

questions.stemEn: A 3-year-old fully vaccinated child presented with fever, hip pain, and inability to bear weight. WBC and ESR were elevated. Synovial fluid Gram stain was provided showing gram-negative coccobacilli. What is the most likely causative organism?
questions.explanationAr: العمر أقل من 4 سنوات مع septic arthritis وGram-negative coccobacilli يجعل Kingella kingae اختيار المصدر. المصدر يذكر أنها من أهم أسباب skeletal infections في الأطفال الصغار.
questions.reasoningEn: The source identifies Kingella kingae as a gram-negative coccobacillus and a leading cause of skeletal infection in young children.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: S. pneumoniae Gram-positive، وH. influenzae أقل اتساقًا مع سياق الطفل fully vaccinated في صياغة المصدر، وPseudomonas لا تتوافق مع الشكل المجهري المذكور.
questions.clinicalPearl: Consider Kingella kingae in children under 4 with osteoarticular infection.

questions.stemEn: A child with a 2-week history of low-grade fever presented with new-onset knee swelling. Gram stain showed gram-negative coccobacilli and a picture was provided. What is the next diagnostic test?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يذكر أن كلًا من Kingella وBrucella قد يظهران Gram-negative coccobacilli، وأن الاختيار بين Brucella titer وsynovial culture غير محسوم تمامًا. لذلك لا نعتمد المفتاح بلا مراجعة.
questions.reasoningEn: The source favors Brucella titer but explicitly states that the question is difficult and that synovial culture may also be relevant.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: لا يمكن اعتبار synovial culture خطأ بشكل قاطع اعتمادًا على المصدر نفسه؛ QuantiFERON لا يتماشى مع brucellosis framing.
questions.clinicalPearl: Osteoarticular brucellosis is common in children and may involve large joints.
diagnosticSteps: Resolve Brucella titer versus synovial culture using current reference before publish.

questions.stemEn: A 7-year-old girl who has a cat at home presented with back pain and fever for 10 days. She had just returned from a 2-week farm visit and was found to have generalized lymphadenopathy and hepatosplenomegaly. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: رغم وجود cat exposure، فإن farm exposure مع fever وback pain وgeneralized lymphadenopathy وhepatosplenomegaly يتماشى في شرح المصدر مع brucellosis أكثر من cat-scratch disease.
questions.reasoningEn: The source favors brucellosis because farm exposure plus systemic findings fit brucellosis better than localized cat-scratch disease.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Cat-scratch disease غالبًا يسبب regional lymphadenopathy قرب موضع الخدش، بينما السيناريو هنا systemic أكثر.
questions.clinicalPearl: Brucellosis may present with fever, arthralgia/back pain, lymphadenopathy, and hepatosplenomegaly.

questions.stemEn: A young boy presented with symptoms and signs suggestive of cat-scratch disease. What is the causative organism?
questions.explanationAr: Cat-scratch disease مرتبطة في المصدر بـ Bartonella henselae، وهي gram-negative bacillus/pleomorphic organism.
questions.reasoningEn: The source identifies Bartonella henselae as the cause of cat-scratch disease.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Bartonella bacilliformis ليست المسبب الكلاسيكي لـ cat-scratch disease.
questions.clinicalPearl: Cat-scratch disease classically causes regional lymphadenopathy after cat or kitten exposure.

questions.stemEn: A young boy presented with neck swelling after playing with his cat and later was found to have scratch marks on his neck. How will you treat him?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار azithromycin في lymphadenitis الناتجة عن cat-scratch disease، ويذكر أن بعض الحالات قد تتحسن دون علاج لكن antimicrobial therapy قد تقصر مدة الأعراض بحسب المرجع الذي نقل عنه.
questions.reasoningEn: The source selects azithromycin for cat-scratch lymphadenitis and lists TMP-SMX as an alternative regimen.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Augmentin وcephalexin ليست الخيارات التي يدعمها شرح المصدر لهذا التشخيص، وTMP-SMX ذُكر كبديل لا كخيار المصدر الأول.
questions.clinicalPearl: Cat-scratch disease often presents with regional lymphadenitis after an inoculation papule or scratch.
managementSteps: Use azithromycin according to the source recall.
